notes: Syrah adds structure and color to Grenache in blends such as Côtes du Rhône and Châteauneuf-du-Pape.
Reds from the left bank are full bodied and tannic when young, with aromas of prune, undergrowth, chocolate and ripe black fruit.
Right bank reds are slightly lighter and fruitier.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône area containing Châteauneuf-du-Pape, Gigondas, Vacqueyras, Rasteau, Tavel, Lirac and most of the Côtes du Rhône and Côtes du Rhône Villages vineyards.
